pull_request.body:
This replaces the accreted program article with a compact five-part structure.

Main changes:
- compress the software-factory ontology to only what is needed to state factory learning
- merge Naur, retained-vs-held theory, and fallible search into one conceptual hinge
- keep natural-language theory as the contingent implementation bet rather than a necessary carrier
- merge testbeds, causal path, evidence ladder, current evidence, and minimum controlled contrasts
- reduce system-boundary, Bitter Lesson, stronger-claims, and failure-condition material to short bridges to their canonical companion homes
- update article-roles.md so future edits preserve the compact five-unit contract

The article now includes the retained theory -> held theory distinction and the corresponding retained-to-held experimental contrast.

Diff: 2 files; the article removes 533 lines and adds 54, while article-roles is similarly compressed.

commits.messageHeadline: Compress learning software factories research program
Align article roles with compressed program statement

pull_request.title: Compress and reorganize learning software factories program
